# PDF import fixtures (feature 016)

Generated by `make-fixtures.py` (Pillow, as `../make-format-fixtures.py`; the tagged file is printed by
Playwright's Chromium through `make-tagged.mjs`). Each `<name>.pdf` has `<name>.expected.json`: the page
kinds, the refusal reason when the import must refuse, and words its text must hold. `--check` regenerates
in memory and fails when a committed file differs (the tagged file excepted: its bytes carry the print time).

- `password-user.pdf`: user password `secret`, owner password `owner`.
- `copy-restricted.pdf`: no user password, owner password `owner`, copying forbidden.
- `hostile/`: damaged and hostile files; each must end with a reason or a model, never a crash.
- `reference-0.0.11-a5.pdf` (task T005): the reference book exported by 0.0.11.
